cover: Designing software for people in grief

slides.title: Ask for less, in smaller pieces
slides.body: One group of questions at a time feels manageable on a hard day, and it suits the phone most people use.

slides.title: Give people words to start from
slides.body: Offer a few preset phrases before an empty box. Finding words for someone else’s loss is hard.

slides.title: Write down the tones to avoid
slides.body: One brief named four: clinical, corporate, greeting-card and funereal. Check every screen against the list.

slides.title: Get the dates exactly right
slides.body: An anniversary kept on the Hebrew calendar moves every year. Work it out fresh, and remind people before the day.

slides.title: Her record is hers
slides.body: Closing an account is her request. Erasing her details later leaves the memorial to her parent in place.
